messages:
maria_cs: Drafted a concise customer-facing runbook for Savoy (renewal demo next week). Focus: predictable demo latency, low token-cost impact, clear consent/feedback path. PTAL.

aj_dev: Can you drop the short checklist for AEs here? Keep it skimmable.

maria_cs: Yep 1-page checklist: 

- Goal: show demo responses that feel instant and consistent.
- Leads: CS (maria_cs) + Eng Enablement (aj_dev).
- Timeline (48h -> 0h):
   48h: reserve warm pool sized to 95th pct expected requests.
   8h: run prefill job with common demo prefixes.
   1h: dry-run full demo with streaming on.
- Recommended customer integration knobs:
   prefill_ttl_sec: 3600
   batch_hint: {batch_size:8, max_latency_ms:50}
   streaming: enabled; fallback to non-stream after 200ms no-chunk
- Observability checks: verify first-byte latency <150ms in dashboard and capture last-3 prompt traces.
- Feedback capture: post-demo 3-question survey + opt-in to attach up to 2 anonymized transcripts. Link: tiny.redwood/feedback-savoy
- Escalation rule: if 95th pct latency >200ms during demo -> switch to 'low-cost' model variant, notify CS oncall and AE.

aj_dev: Prefill script we recommend: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/prefill" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tenant":"savoy","prompt":"demo-seed","pool_size":10,"ttl_sec":3600}'
```

maria_cs: Add a tiny JSON snippet customers can paste: 
```json
{"batch_size":"8","max_latency_ms":"50","enable_stream":"true","stream_fallback_ms":"200"}
```

kevin_pm: Add two measurable success metrics for renewal deck: "first-byte latency <150ms" and "token cost uplift <8% during demo compared to steady-state". Also note 3-day post-demo check-in to collect survey.

elena_support: Add GDPR consent wording for EU customers and ensure survey uses anonymized transcripts only with opt-in. Suggest copy: "I consent to share anonymized transcripts for quality review."

maria_cs: Added consent line & updated survey flow.

aj_dev: Two engineering tips for handoff: 1) if customer uses custom system prompts, include exact variant in prefill to avoid prompt drift. 2) If warm pool doesn't reach target, enable 'soft-warm' that creates KV caches for top prefixes.

maria_cs: Added short troubleshooting at bottom: 
- Symptom: warm pool empty at demo start -> Action: run prefill with pool_size=2x baseline; enable soft-warm; ping eng-infra.
- Symptom: streaming stalls -> Action: reduce stream_fallback_ms to 150 and restart session.
- Symptom: hallucination spike after prefill -> Action: rollback prefill, run eval set, escalate to research.

ops_bot: Automated reminder: reserve dedicated capacity 2024-11-20T16:00:00Z for tenant 'savoy'. Reply :thumbsup: to confirm.

kevin_pm: One-line risk summary for AE: "Risk: renewal sensitive to demo latency and hallucination; mitigation: warm pools + prefills + rollback plan."

maria_cs: Final: I'll run a dry-run Thursday 14:00 with aj_dev + elena_support. Sending the one-pager to AE after dry-run. Leaving this thread for audit: checklist + snippets + escalation path. :white_check_mark:
